consentSubtitle: {{app}} is asking for access to your OpenKeep account.
grantsTitle: If you allow, it will be able to:
grantRead: Read every note, label, reminder and attachment in your account
grantWrite: Create, edit, archive and delete notes on your behalf
grantSettings: Read and change your account settings
protectedNotesSafe: Protected notes stay hidden — unlocking one needs your password or PIN, which a connected app is never asked for.
unverifiedTitle: OpenKeep has not verified this app
unverifiedBody: Anything below was written by whoever registered it. Only continue if you started this from an app you trust.
invalidRequest: This authorization link is invalid or has expired. Start the connection again from the app.
error: Something went wrong. Start the connection again from the app.
connectionsDescription: Apps you authorized to reach your notes over OAuth. Revoking one cuts its access immediately.
disconnectConfirm: Disconnect {{app}}? It will lose access to your notes right away.
